profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft

positions.title: Active Member
positions.description: Part of the TISAM (Tutoring in Science and Mathematics), Outreach and School Visits Committee

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: Have a leadership role to help members acquire new professional and leadership skills, make important decisions, advise executive members and maintain clear communication between different committees. Resolve conflicts between members through communication.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented a recommendation engine microservice to generate insights based on Chase customer events and activities.
- Leveraged from the Java-based rules engine EasyRules, to create rules and evaluate customer data.
- Designed and developed an UI where the business team can change business rules in real-time.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented automatic generation and calculation of client monthly billing reports.
- Created a component to display the client's monthly plan usage rate in real-time.
- Implemented personalization of client campaign messages sent by SMS and dynamically calculated the total sum of messages sent.

positions.title: Telemetry Department Programmer
positions.description:
The Telemetry team is in charge of the retrieval, storage, display and analysis of rover data by using sensors throughout the rover, collecting information and sending it via a private network to the ground station. The information is processed and displayed in the graphical user interface and have a quick reference of the status of the buggy. Some of the tools and frameworks we use are: Angular for the front-end, Node.js and Express for the back-end, and PostgreSQL for the database. 

Finish basic CRUD operations and implement error handling for such methods, and establish new table relationship design.

positions.title: Research: Predicting Trip Cancellations and No-Shows in Paratransit Operations
positions.description:
Improve the productivity of transit agencies by predicting which trip reservations will result in trips by implementing machine learning algorithms with trip reservation data provided by the Metropolitan Bus Authority of Puerto Rico.

Helped refactor code that was already implemented to have a more object-oriented approach to reuse code, develop a relationship between predicting models, and made easier to understand and debug. Created and maintained a Linux VM in Google Cloud Platform for the execution of scripts.

positions.title: Confidential Systems Analyst Programmer
positions.description:
Worked at the Laboratory of Technology and Software Development with a group of software engineering and computer science students to develop web applications for the enrichment and use of the Judicial Branch under the Agile software development methodology applied with Scrum. Used tools and technologies like Django, Postresql, Jenkins, JMeter and Selenium. 

Developed a file uploading scheme with Django for saving the contents of a file in the database for different models. Search and identify bottlenecks and inefficient queries that were affecting significantly the performance of the app by optimizing the use of the Django ORM and Admin. Carry out performance tests using Apache JMeter to identify performance issues of the server hosting the app and the app itself. Implemented a custom test runner to create a test suite to gather and execute tests specifically for production use.
